parsed.rationale: Both `RadioPlayer.handlePlaybackStalled` (line 141) and `HLSPlayer.handlePlaybackStalled` (line 210) are flagged as exact function duplicates within the same `Playback` package. Because the implementations are identical and both classes are player types in the same package, the most idiomatic Swift resolution is to define a shared player protocol (e.g., `PlayerProtocol`) and provide a default implementation of `handlePlaybackStalled()` in a protocol extension, eliminating the duplicated body from both conforming types.
